FNaF: DAYBREAK

Download Now

Remember when I made a visual novel about FNaF characters three years ago? I did it again :D

----------------------------------------

"Welcome back to your job at Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex! Apologies for any issues you may have had during your first week, we've done a few things in our power to make your experience as tolerable as possible! Keep going, trooper! I'm sure nothing else will go wrong during your time here!"

----------------------------------------


You're going through the motions of your night shift job at a glorified robot mall. Why? Who knows. Yeah, you got attacked during your very first week on the job, but who has time to worry about that now? You sure don't.

You're too busy managing everyday tech problems and making friends with robots to worry about any of that, right? Right?

--Night 2 is here!--

Night 2 of this fangame includes:

  • Seven CGs
  • Voice acting for all major characters
  • ~25k words
  • Some short minigames!
  • Many silly robot friends! :D

The full release of this fangame WILL include:

  • Gender neutral player character
  • 100k+ words
  • More minigames
  • Platonic AND romantic dialogue options!
  • Six endings
  • Secrets!

--Night 3 release date TBD--

----------------------------------------

!!CONTENT WARNINGS:!!

This game includes/will include strong language, occasional suggestive language, physical violence, loud noises and visual effects that may cause eye strain!

----------------------------------------
